timestamp_utc.definition: UTC timestamp for each aligned race record, stored at 1-second resolution in the totalraces analytics layer.
timestamp_utc.purpose: Acts as the shared time key so all sailors in the same race_id can be aligned and compared on the same race timeline.

latitude.definition: Boat latitude in decimal degrees for the sailor position at each timestamp_utc.
latitude.purpose: Used to represent the boat’s geographic position for track plotting and for all location-based race calculations.

longitude.definition: Boat longitude in decimal degrees for the sailor position at each timestamp_utc.
longitude.purpose: Used with latitude to define the boat track and support spatial calculations against marks, legs, and targets.

heart_rate.definition: Recorded sailor heart rate value for that timestamp, stored as an integer and varying through the race.
heart_rate.purpose: Provides physiological effort data that can be analyzed alongside boat movement and race progression.

finish_time_utc.definition: UTC timestamp of that sailor’s race finish, repeated across all rows in the file.
finish_time_utc.purpose: Provides the per-sailor finish reference used to identify race completion timing within the aligned race dataset.

elapsed_race_time_s.definition: Total race time in seconds measured from verified start to finish-line crossing, repeated across all rows.
elapsed_race_time_s.purpose: Provides the final race duration used for ranking and race-level comparison between sailors.

finished_flag.definition: Binary indicator showing whether the sailor has a recorded finish in that race file, with observed value 1 for finished rows.
finished_flag.purpose: Marks whether the race result is complete for the sailor so finished and unfinished tracks can be distinguished in analytics.

seg_dist_m.definition: Distance traveled during the current 1-second segment, in meters, with 0 when the position does not change.
seg_dist_m.purpose: Provides the step-by-step movement measure used to quantify instantaneous progress and build cumulative distance metrics.

dist_from_start_m.definition: Cumulative distance traveled from the first row of the race file, in meters.
dist_from_start_m.purpose: Tracks how much path length the boat has covered since the aligned race start for progression and workload analysis.

SOG_raw_mpm.definition: Raw speed over ground derived from movement between consecutive points, expressed in meters per minute.
SOG_raw_mpm.purpose: Captures unprocessed boat speed for second-by-second performance analysis before any higher-level tactical interpretation.

COG_raw_deg.definition: Raw course over ground in degrees derived from consecutive positions, with 0 when no movement is recorded.
COG_raw_deg.purpose: Represents the boat’s immediate travel direction for each segment before the direction is normalized into analytics fields.

geom_leg_id.definition: Geometry-defined leg identifier showing which course leg the boat is assigned to at that timestamp.
geom_leg_id.purpose: Links each record to the race geometry so position and progress can be interpreted in the context of course structure.

geom_from_mark.definition: Name or label of the mark the current geometry leg starts from.
geom_from_mark.purpose: Defines the origin of the active leg so the boat’s current course segment can be understood relative to race marks.

geom_to_mark.definition: Name or identifier of the mark the current geometry leg is heading toward for that row.
geom_to_mark.purpose: Identifies the active destination mark used to evaluate current leg progress and targeting.

geom_leg_bearing_deg.definition: Bearing in degrees of the current geometry leg from geom_from_mark toward geom_to_mark.
geom_leg_bearing_deg.purpose: Provides the reference course direction for leg-based comparisons such as heading alignment and tactical offset analysis.

target_lat_deg.definition: Latitude in decimal degrees of the active target mark associated with the current row.
target_lat_deg.purpose: Supplies the target mark position needed for distance and bearing calculations from the boat to its current objective.

target_lon_deg.definition: Longitude in decimal degrees of the active target mark associated with the current row.
target_lon_deg.purpose: Works with target_lat_deg to define the destination point used in mark-targeting and leg-progress calculations.

dist_to_target_m.definition: Current distance from the boat position to the active target mark, in meters.
dist_to_target_m.purpose: Measures remaining straight-line distance to the next mark for progress tracking and tactical assessment.

bearing_to_target_deg.definition: Bearing in degrees from the boat’s current position to the active target mark.
bearing_to_target_deg.purpose: Defines the direct direction to the target mark so boat direction can be compared against the shortest path to target.

COG_deg.definition: Processed course over ground in degrees used by the analytics layer.
COG_deg.purpose: Provides the normalized boat travel direction used in downstream tactical and leg-relative calculations.

ATB_angle_deg.definition: Absolute angular difference between COG_deg and bearing_to_target_deg, expressed in degrees.
ATB_angle_deg.purpose: Quantifies how directly the boat is sailing toward the target mark for tactical efficiency analysis.

ATB_offset_deg.definition: Signed angular difference between COG_deg and bearing_to_target_deg indicating side of the direct target line.
ATB_offset_deg.purpose: Shows whether the boat is offset left or right of the direct line to the target mark.

axis_angle_signed_deg.definition: Signed angular difference between COG_deg and geom_leg_bearing_deg.
axis_angle_signed_deg.purpose: Indicates which side of the leg axis the boat is sailing on.

is_upwind.definition: Boolean flag indicating whether the current geometry context is classified as upwind.
is_upwind.purpose: Separates upwind from non-upwind sailing so analytics can apply correct tactical interpretation.

upwind_dist_remaining_m.definition: Remaining upwind distance measure in meters for the current row when in an upwind context.
upwind_dist_remaining_m.purpose: Tracks how much upwind course distance remains for progress assessment.
